record.paper_title: Open Problems and Conjectures Related to the Theory of Mathematical Quasicrystals
record.original_question: Let (V,E) be the graph of the Penrose tiling and define H on l²(V) by [Hψ](v)=∑_{w:(v,w)∈E}(ψ(w)-ψ(v)). Determine the spectrum σ(H) of this operator.

evidence.quote: Consider for example the Penrose tiling and the corresponding graph (V, E), where V is the vertex set and E the set of edges. Define the operator H in the space l2(V) as follows: for any ψ ∈ l2(V) and any v ∈ V, let [Hψ](v) := ∑_{w :(v,w)∈E}(ψ(w) − ψ(v)). Problem 2.1.2 Determine the spectrum σ (H) of the operator defined above.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(V,E)$ be the (undirected) graph whose vertex set $V$ consists of the vertices of a Penrose tiling of the plane (taken, e.g., as a fixed rhombic Penrose tiling), and whose edge set $E$ consists of the unordered pairs $\{v,w\}$ such that $v$ and $w$ are endpoints of a common edge of a tile. The graph is locally finite (each vertex has bounded degree). Define the bounded self-adjoint operator $H$ on the Hilbert space $\ell^2(V)$ by
$$[H\psi](v) \;=\; \sum_{w:\,\{v,w\}\in E}\bigl(\psi(w)-\psi(v)\bigr), \qquad \psi\in\ell^2(V),\ v\in V.$$
Determine the spectrum $\sigma(H)\subset\mathbb{R}$ of this graph Laplacian.
artifact.category_tag: Spectra of Laplacians on aperiodic tilings
artifact.status_search_result: The full spectrum of the Penrose-tiling graph Laplacian is not known. Recent work (e.g., Embree et al., Experimental Mathematics 33 (2024)) studies the integrated density of states for graph Laplacians on Penrose and Ammann–Beenker tilings, exhibiting locally-supported eigenfunctions and lower bounds on jumps in the IDS, but does not give a complete description of σ(H). The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Discontinuities of the Integrated Density of States for Laplacians Associated with Penrose and Ammann–Beenker Tilings
status_evidence.snippet: Studies graph Laplacians on Penrose-class tilings, exhibits locally-supported eigenfunctions, and gives lower bounds on jumps in the integrated density of states; raises further questions on spectral properties.
status_evidence.claim: Recent partial progress; full spectrum not determined.

status_evidence.title: Open Problems and Conjectures Related to the Theory of Mathematical Quasicrystals
status_evidence.snippet: Lists the determination of σ(H) for the Penrose graph Laplacian as an open problem.
